components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid dark indigo action button with hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #11143d; color: #f8f9ff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #302b9b; color: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(48, 43, 155, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Crisp paper button used over dark hero canvas and featured banners.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-light { background: #f8f9ff; color: #11143d; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: #ffffff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(17, 20, 61, 0.15); } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Service List Row
components.description: Structured gathering schedule row with interactive hover state.
components.html:
Sunday9:00 AM - 11:00 AM

Morning Worship & Word

Biblical teaching, worship, and prayer for the entire family.
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 28px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd3ef; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-service-row:hover { background-color: #edf0ff; } .ds-service-time { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #11143d; } .ds-service-time span { font-size: 11px; color: #5d6384; } .ds-service-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #11143d; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-service-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #5d6384; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-row-arrow { color: #302b9b; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-service-row:hover .ds-row-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

components.name: Underline Text Field
components.description: Minimalist underline input field with smooth indigo focus stroke.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: #5d6384; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #cfd3ef; background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; color: #11143d; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #302b9b; }

narrative.overview:
The Hiwot Birhan visual language combines the dignity and reverence of an established Ethiopian church family with open, contemporary warmth. Rather than relying on generic SaaS cards or heavy drop shadows, the aesthetic is anchored in rich editorial serif typography, deliberate contrast, and deep royal indigo tones balanced against clean, cool paper surfaces.

Every element communicates hospitality, spiritual grounding, and community life. Dense, rhythmic service schedules and clear event timelines are rendered with structured row layouts rather than cluttered floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Reverent Editorial Headlines: Grand DM Serif Display headings paired with italic emphasis words in lavender accent.
Tonal Canvas Depth: Crisp #f8f9ff base with layered #edf0ff and #dfe4ff surfaces rather than decorative shadow halos.
Structured Row Architecture: Flat, horizontal service and event items separated by delicate borders with interactive directional hover cues.
Clear Communal Purpose: Direct, compassionate copy free of generic placeholder slop, tailored specifically for the Addis Ababa Summit community.

rules.name: The Sanctuary Accent Rule
rules.body: The vibrant lavender accent (#6569d8) is reserved for moments of emphasis (italic headline keywords, tag labels, and quote iconography). It is never applied as a solid container fill.

rules.name: The No-Dead-Gray Rule
rules.body: Neutral borders and muted text are always tinted with soft indigo undertones (#cfd3ef, #5d6384), never sterile monochrome grays.

rules.name: The Natural Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Headings use italic serif styling with the accent color on key phrases to create human warmth and melodic cadence.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces and cards remain flat at rest. Subtle depth and translation occur solely in response to user focus and hover interactions.

dos: Do preserve the authentic church name (Hiwot Birhan Addis Ababa Summit branch) and local Addis Ababa context across all copies.
Do use DM Serif Display for major headlines and allow headings to speak with italic accents.
Do use structured row dividers (1px solid #cfd3ef) for time-based items instead of floating card grids.
Do tint all secondary neutrals and backgrounds with cool indigo hues.
donts: Don't add arbitrary numbered labels (01 / Welcome, 02 / Join us) or kicker eyebrows above headings.
Don't use generic stock church template names (e.g. Harbor Church, Portland, OR).
Don't introduce heavy multi-color gradient text or gratuitous glassmorphism blur effects.
Don't use pure monochrome gray borders or black shadows without indigo tinting.
